references.text: The prophecy in Isaiah about the suffering of God's servant reflects Jesus' suffering and death as described in Matthew 20:18.
Psalm 22 describes the suffering of a righteous person, which can be seen as a prediction of Jesus' suffering and death.
Luke gives a parallel account of Jesus' prediction of his suffering, death, and resurrection.
Mark also gives a parallel account of Jesus' prediction of his suffering, death, and resurrection.
John mentions Jesus' prediction about being lifted up from the earth, which can be interpreted as a reference to his crucifixion and death.
